name: scroll-menu-phone
title: Scroll Menu Phone
description: A generic phone frame with a menu list. The list scrolls with momentum, a touch dot taps an item, and the item expands to show its price and a Tambah button, which the dot then taps and a cart count appears. Names, descriptions and prices come from one variable.
useWhen: Showing that a shop can be ordered from on a phone: a menu, a catalogue, a price list.
A walkthrough of choosing one item from many.
avoidWhen: A menu that should be read in full: use menu-price-board.
author: Mosio

source.technique: phone mockup with scroll and tap

variables.label: Caption
variables.description: Line beside or above the phone. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Menu items
variables.description: One per line, Name|Description|Price. At least 5 lines work best.
